_about: Public-domain Augustus H. Strong (Augustus Hopkins Strong, 1836-1921, Baptist, president of Rochester Theological Seminary) for the Word Hoard: the three-volume Systematic Theology (1907-1909) and A Tour of the Missions (1918) from Project Gutenberg, and from Internet Archive scans his 1876 Lectures on Theology, the 1886 first edition of the Systematic Theology, Philosophy and Religion, Christ in Creation and Ethical Monism, the Miscellanies and twelve other books and addresses. His later theology moved toward ethical monism; veto point. Not James Strong of the Concordance. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 18 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
